name: East African volcanoes
region: Kilimanjaro and Mount Kenya (Rwenzori is far wetter).
sources: Mölg, T. et al. (2009) Quantifying climate change in the tropical midtroposphere over East Africa from glacier shrinkage on Kilimanjaro. Journal of Climate 22
Hemp, A. (2006) Continuum or zonation? Altitudinal gradients in the forest vegetation of Mt. Kilimanjaro (rainfall gradient). Plant Ecology 184
Hardy, D. R. Kilimanjaro summit automatic weather station records (University of Massachusetts Climate System Research Center)
